description: This Java class defines the QuarterlyCompoundingPeriod, which implements interest calculation logic for a specific period, including methods for interest computation based on daily and average daily balances, and handles collections of end-of-day balances within a period.

classes.name: QuarterlyCompoundingPeriod
classes.description: Implements interest calculation over quarterly periods, managing a range of interest calculation methods, and maintaining a list of end-of-day balances within the period.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Factory method to instantiate a QuarterlyCompoundingPeriod object for a given date interval, filtering relevant end-of-day balances up to a specific interest calculation date.

methods.name: calculateInterest
methods.description: Calculates interest based on the specified interest calculation type (daily balance or average daily balance), interest rate, period days, and balance data.

methods.name: calculateUsingAverageDailyBalanceMethod
methods.description: Computes interest based on the average daily balance over the period, applying minimum balance thresholds for interest eligibility.

methods.name: calculateUsingDailyBalanceMethod
methods.description: Calculates interest based on daily or monthly interest accruals, iterating over each balance day within the period.

methods.name: endOfDayBalancesWithinPeriodInterval
methods.description: Filters end-of-day balances to those within the specified period interval, respecting end-of-day adjustments.

methods.name: getPeriodInterval
methods.description: Returns the date interval representing the interest period.
